name: ldmx-sw
description: The Light Dark Matter eXperiment simulation and reconstruction framework.

paragraphs: ldmx-sw is a large software project and so it is helpful to separate using it to perform physics studies from developing it to fix/improve/enable other studies. In both cases, we use containers to share a fixed software environment, so everyone will need a method for running these containers.

Some folks may see an error about something not being within your PATH, you just need to update your shell's configuration to look for denv within that directory. A program being "in your PATH" can be checked by making sure your shell can find it.
The above should printout a help message instead of a "command not found" message.
features: Only necessary on personal computers. Shared computing clusters should have apptainer installed.
(on Linux personal computers) Manage docker as non-root user
